findings.evidence: R15 idempotent endpoints are marked x-idempotent in the frozen contracts, e.g. /api/v1/support/tickets/{id}/messages at contracts/openapi.yaml:12231 and admin support messages at contracts/admin-openapi.yaml:10192. The service only calls commandHash(...) and then immediately inserts ticket_messages/admin_operation_logs/outbox_events at lines 232-241; commandHash itself only validates/hashes and returns a value at lines 401-410, with no claim/replay/complete persistence. Repeating the same X-Idempotency-Key will duplicate messages, audit rows, and outbox events.
findings.issue: R15 command idempotency is not implemented; the candidate only validates the key shape and does not persist or replay idempotent command results.
findings.requirement_ref: ACTIVE_TASK.deliverables: 权限/幂等/错误码/审计覆盖; OpenAPI x-idempotent=true

findings.evidence: The frozen admin decide request schemas require expectedVersion for content reports, appeals, and chat reports at contracts/admin-openapi.yaml:22002-22013, 22110-22121, and 25220-25231. R15Service.decide hashes only operation/admin/id/decision/reason, never checks request.expectedVersion(), then writes audit/outbox and returns DECIDED at lines 264-270. The store update methods return void and ignore jdbc.update counts, e.g. content_reports at lines 184-186 and chat_reports at lines 223-225, so stale or nonexistent resources can still produce success/audit/outbox evidence.
findings.issue: Admin decide operations ignore required optimistic version and update row count, allowing stale or nonexistent reports/appeals/chat reports to be reported as successfully decided.
findings.requirement_ref: ACTIVE_TASK.acceptance: OpenAPI契约测试; 权限/幂等/错误码/审计覆盖

findings.evidence: Frozen support message requests require only content, not expectedVersion, at contracts/openapi.yaml:20813-20826 and contracts/admin-openapi.yaml:25380-25393, but TicketMessageRequest requires @NotNull expectedVersion at lines 59-62. Admin assign requires assigneeId in the contract at contracts/admin-openapi.yaml:25347-25358, while AssignTicketRequest exposes assignee at lines 64-66. Admin close exposes reason in the contract at contracts/admin-openapi.yaml:25419-25424, while CloseTicketRequest requires resolution at lines 68-70.
findings.issue: R15 support command DTOs do not match the frozen OpenAPI request schemas, so valid contract payloads will be rejected or mapped to the wrong fields.

findings.evidence: adminTicket is annotated @Transactional(readOnly = true) and calls store.lockAdminTicket at lines 208-210. R15PostgresStore.lockAdminTicket uses SELECT ... FOR UPDATE OF t at lines 129-130. On PostgreSQL, SELECT FOR UPDATE is not allowed in a read-only transaction, so GET /admin-api/v1/support/tickets/{id} can fail at runtime.
findings.issue: The admin support-ticket detail read path uses a FOR UPDATE lock inside a read-only transaction.
findings.requirement_ref: TASK-R15-RECOVERY-006 objective: implement scope operationIds with real backend behavior

summary: Candidate does not satisfy TASK-R15-RECOVERY-006. I found no test deletions under tests/ in the reviewed diff, but the added regression test is only static string checking and does not catch the contract/idempotency/runtime failures above.
